art.title: Paris Street; Rainy Day
art.story: A wet afternoon at a crossroads in the brand-new Paris, rebuilt with wide streets and tall cream buildings. A well-dressed couple under one umbrella walks towards us; the paving stones shine with rain; a green lamppost cuts the picture in two. Everyone keeps to themselves, like strangers in a modern city. Caillebotte was a rich young painter who also helped his friends: he bought their work when no one else would, and left it to the nation.
